```{r}
#remotes::install_github("ropensci/USAboundaries")
#remotes::install_github("ropensci/USAboundariesData")

library(tidyverse)
library(USAboundaries) # for US state boundaries
library(sf) # for US map
library(daymetr)
```

```{r}
training_merged_US_1 <- read_csv("../data/training_merged_US_1.csv")

training_merged_US_1

daymet_one <- download_daymet(site = training_merged_US_1$site[1],
                              lat = training_merged_US_1$latitude[1],
                              lon = training_merged_US_1$longitude[1],
                              start = training_merged_US_1$year[1],
                              end = training_merged_US_1$year[1],
                              simplify = T
                              )

daymet_one
```

```{r}
daymet_all <- training_merged1 %>%
  mutate(weather = pmap(list(.y = year,
                             .site = site,
                             .lat = latitude,
                             .lon = longitude),
                        function(.y, .site, .lat, .lon)
                          download_daymet(
                                          site = .site,
                                          lat = .lat,
                                          lon = .lon,
                                          start = .y,
                                          end = .y,
                                          simplify = T,
                                          silent = T) %>%
                          rename(.year = year,
                                 .site = site)
                          
                        ))

daymet_all
```
